_doc: Role -> catalog-description regex (case-insensitive) used by codex-models.js against ~/.codex/models_cache.json. Edit here, not in code. Each role lists alternatives; a visible model matches if its description matches any. Catalog wording changes between Codex releases (0.166 said 'frontier'/'workhorse'; 0.171 says 'most capable'/'go-to model'), so add the new phrasing here when a role stops resolving.
